capabilities: Merge community and core plugin lists into a single Plugins tab
Group plugins into collapsible, renameable folders
Install community plugins directly into a chosen folder
Hide or show plugin options in the Preferences sidebar
disambiguation: Not a plugin installer or manager for enabling/disabling plugins; it only organizes and displays the existing plugin lists in settings.
extras: Overrides Obsidian's built-in plugin tabs while enabled (the README carries an 'IMPORTANT FOR REVIEW: This plugin overrides Obsidian's native functionality' warning); desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. The replaced Community plugins/Core plugins tabs are not among the listed core features, so coreOverlap is recorded as none.
intentEvidence: Merges the Community plugins and Core plugins tabs into a single Plugins tab.
problem: Obsidian's plugin lists live in separate tabs with no way to group plugins, making large plugin collections hard to browse.
summary: Plugin-list organizer that merges the community and core plugin tabs into one Plugins tab with collapsible folders.
